dream_job_live.why: POST /api/memory/dream while the user's previous review of recent work is still queued or running (harness/dream.py; one live job per user, a partial unique index). Nothing new was queued; the Memory page shows the running job.

dream_budget_exhausted.why: A dream job reached its token cap (PYPSA_GUI_DREAM_JOB_TOKENS, or the user's remaining daily dream budget) before its next model call (harness/dream.py). The job ends capped; the lessons proposed so far are kept and the next job continues from its cursor.

dream_restarts.why: A dream job's worker stopped three times within an hour without finishing (harness/dream.py, the runner's crash-loop rule). The job is failed; proposals written before stay, and a new review can be started.

dream_provider_error.why: The provider of the active profile failed a dream job's model call (harness/dream.py). The job is failed; candidates gathered so far are proposed and the next job re-reads the source that failed.

dream_user_inactive.why: A dream job's user no longer exists or is deactivated (harness/dream.py). The job is failed without reading anything.
